title: Nvidia to rent back its GPUs from Lambda for ~$1.5B

sources.quote: Nvidia has agreed to a $1.5 billion contract to lease GPU servers from Lambda, an AI infrastructure company offering on-demand GPUs, according to a report by The Information.

explain: According to a report by The Information, Nvidia agreed to pay Lambda about $1.5 billion over four years to rent servers built with Nvidia's own chips. Nvidia is also a Lambda shareholder, so it sells the chips, invests and then rents them back.
